ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Of DBGCORE.DLL
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects DLL sideloading of "dbgcore.dll" Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\dbgcore\\\.dll$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SoftwareDistribution\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SystemTemp\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\"))) AND  NOT (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\Steam\\\\bin\\\\cef\\\\cef\\\.win7x64\\\\dbgcore\\\.dll$"))
